purpose: Evidence-based scientific validation status; a passing software test is not equivalent to device validation.

shot_30421.calibration: archive values not treated as calibrated physical measurements

benchmarks.reference: Alipour, Ghoranneviss & Salar Elahi, AIP Advances 7, 115303 (2017), DOI 10.1063/1.4990869
benchmarks.method: Quadrature subtraction of published measured and resolution FWHM; convert Doppler FWHM to Gaussian sigma; compute Ti with the code's Doppler relation; compare to published Table VII.
benchmarks.tolerance: Published Ti values within 0.5%; reconstructed Doppler FWHM within 2e-5 nm.
benchmarks.limitation: Original CCD line-profile samples are not available in the paper text, so this reproduces tabulated results rather than refitting the raw spectrum. Not device validation.

benchmarks.reference: Alipour et al., Review of Scientific Instruments 88, 093516 (2017), DOI 10.1063/1.4994037
benchmarks.method: Calculate ion sound speed from reported Te≈14 eV and hydrogen ion mass; compare M_parallel≈0.5 times sound speed with reported mean flow ≈17 km/s.
benchmarks.tolerance: 10% on the rounded reported flow value.
benchmarks.limitation: Published summary values only; raw I–V sweeps and channel-level calibration are unavailable. This is not validation of I–V fitting or density extraction.

benchmarks.method: Recover exact synthetic Gaussian center, sigma, and FWHM.
benchmarks.limitation: Does not validate line identification, blends, wavelength calibration, instrument-function deconvolution, or experimental uncertainties.

benchmarks.method: Recover Te from a generated exponential electron-retarding branch and fixed ion-current baseline.
benchmarks.limitation: Does not validate a real probe sweep, sheath model, fit-window sensitivity, collection geometry, or density estimate.

benchmarks.method: Analytic sine FFT amplitude/frequency, Welch variance normalization, covariance flux, finite-value checks and filter behavior.
benchmarks.limitation: Synthetic signal correctness does not establish calibrated MHD mode identification or a physical transport result.

benchmarks.method: Fetch fixed public shots/signals, check finite samples and monotonic time, run FFT/Welch/filter, and export an EFIT grid snapshot.
benchmarks.limitation: Raw signals have unspecified units/calibration; grid dimensions and finite values alone do not validate EFIT flux semantics or an equilibrium reconstruction.

benchmarks.method: Independent numerical checks for Greenwald density, beta metrics, IPB98(y,2), Martin 2008 L-H threshold, pressure, Debye length and related formula invariants.
benchmarks.limitation: Empirical scalings require the stated units, regimes and averaging conventions; no universal device-specific predictive validation is claimed.
No independently sourced calibrated multichannel phase/mode reference has yet been reproduced.
Publicly accessible raw CCD spectra and raw probe I–V sweep data with sufficient calibration/provenance were not available for direct reconstruction in this validation run.
